contexts.text: I fell down before his feet to worship him; and he said to me, See thou do it not () = that the Angels are not to be adored and invoked.
To fall down = humiliation, reception, and acknowledgement.
They fell down before the Lamb () = acknowledgement from a humble heart.
The reason to fall down = humiliation of heart, is that a falling down upon the knees and upon the face, is a gesture which corresponds to inmost humiliation.

I fell down before his feet to adore him = perception from him of the Divine, to which belongs adoration; (for) to fall down before the feet, and adore = to acknowledge, to confess, and to worship the Divine.
